title: Time & Calendar
description: Class 2 IMO — Time and calendar: reading clocks to the hour and half hour, days of the week, months and ordering events for the Maths Olympiad.

topics.title: Reading the Clock
topics.concept: A clock has an hour hand (short) and a minute hand (long). When the minute hand points to 12, it is an o'clock time. When it points to 6, it is half past the hour. There are 60 minutes in 1 hour.

examples.problem: The hour hand is on 3 and the minute hand on 12. What time is it?
The minute hand is on 6 and the hour hand between 4 and 5. What time?

recap: Short hand = hour; long hand = minute.
Minute hand on 12 = o'clock; on 6 = half past.

quiz.q: When the minute hand points to 12, the time is ___ ?
quiz.explanation: Minute hand on 12 means an o'clock time.

quiz.q: How many minutes are in 1 hour?

topics.title: Days of the Week
topics.concept: There are 7 days in a week: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday. Yesterday is the day before today and tomorrow is the day after. We use these to talk about when things happen.

examples.problem: How many days are in a week?
If today is Monday, what is tomorrow?

recap: A week has 7 days, Sunday to Saturday.
Yesterday = day before; tomorrow = day after.

quiz.q: If today is Friday, what was yesterday?
quiz.explanation: The day before Friday is Thursday.

topics.title: Months & the Calendar
topics.concept: There are 12 months in a year, from January to December. Most months have 30 or 31 days; February has 28 (or 29 in a leap year). A calendar helps us find dates and days. We also order events using before and after.

examples.problem: How many months are in a year?
Which month comes just after June?

recap: A year has 12 months (January to December).
Most months have 30 or 31 days; February has 28/29.

quiz.q: Which month comes just before August?
How many months are in a year?
quiz.explanation: There are 12 months in a year.

questions.q: Odd one out (three are days, one is not):  Monday, Friday, January, Sunday?
questions.explanation: January is a month; the others are days.

questions.q: Sunday is to week as January is to ___ ?
questions.explanation: Sunday is part of a week; January is part of a year.

questions.q: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 2 days?
The short hand of a clock shows the ___ ?
questions.explanation: The short hand is the hour hand.

questions.q: Half past 7 is the same as ___ ?
How many days are there in 3 weeks?
How many hours are there from 2 o'clock to 5 o'clock?
School starts at 8 o'clock and lasts 6 hours. When does it end?
questions.explanation: 8 + 6 = 14, which is 2 o'clock in the afternoon.

questions.q: A cartoon starts at 4:00 and ends at 4:30. How long is it?
Riya's birthday is in the month after November. Which month is it?
questions.explanation: The month after November is December.

questions.q: A holiday is from 12 June to 16 June. How many days is the holiday (counting both days)?
Today is Saturday. What day will it be after 7 days?
questions.explanation: After exactly 7 days it is the same day — Saturday.
